Comment: FraudFirst time-aware response orchestration. Guides the victim through a durable, ordered response plan. No external action (bank contact, 1930 contact, cybercrime report, freeze, recovery) is performed automatically: every step waits on an explicit SendTaskSuccess that only the app issues after the USER marks the action complete. Supports five response actions: preserve_evidence, contact_bank, contact_1930, report_cybercrime, follow_up.

INCIDENT_STARTED.Comment: Workflow boundary. Input is safe incident metadata only (incidentId, startedAt, currentAction, amount, currency). No raw evidence, OCR text, credentials, or unnecessary PII is ever passed in.

PRESERVE_EVIDENCE.Comment: Action 1/5. Stays pending until the user explicitly marks 'Preserve evidence' complete in the app. The bridge Lambda forwards the task token to the single-table record so the app can SendTaskSuccess.

CONTACT_BANK.Comment: Action 2/5. Pending human action - contacting the bank/payment provider. Never auto-completed.

CONTACT_1930.Comment: Action 3/5. Pending human action - contacting the national cybercrime helpline 1930. Never auto-completed.

REPORT_CYBERCRIME.Comment: Action 4/5. Pending human action - filing a report through the official online cybercrime channel. Never auto-completed.

FOLLOW_UP.Comment: Action 5/5. Pending human action - continuing to monitor the case. Never auto-completed.

RESPONSE_COMPLETE.Comment: All five guided steps were explicitly marked complete by the user. The durable record that the victim finished the guided response plan.
